world.title: A missing letter on a 1964 Welsh map sparked a driveway row; after a glampsite owner tried to stop neighbours parking in their own garden, she lost, faced £135,000 in costs and is now appealing
world.summary: A Welsh glamping site owner has been ordered to pay £135,000 in legal costs following a dispute regarding her neighbours' access to their driveway. The conflict arose after she attempted to prevent them from parking in their garden. The owner is now appealing the decision, which stemmed from a missing letter on a 1964 map.

world.title: Watch: Russian warship hit by suspected Ukrainian drones at Benghazi naval base, bursts into flames
world.summary: A suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack targeted the Russian navy corvette Merkury at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya. The strike resulted in significant damage, causing an explosion and fire on the vessel. The incident highlights ongoing tensions in the region and the use of drone technology in maritime conflicts, further complicating the situation between Ukraine and Russia.

world.title: US Democrats secure 258 House seats, biggest election win since 1992
world.summary: US Democrats have achieved a significant victory by securing at least 258 seats in the House of Representatives, their best performance since 1992. This commanding majority allows them to pursue an ambitious affordability agenda and conduct extensive oversight of the Trump administration. The election results reflect a shift in voter sentiment and provide Democrats with substantial legislative power moving forward.

business.title: D-Street poised for a gap-up start as GIFT Nifty trades firmly higher
business.summary: Indian stock markets are set for a gap-up start as GIFT Nifty shows strong gains. On Friday, domestic purchases fueled a significant upswing, despite weaker global trends. The banking sector contributed notably, resulting in weekly gains of 5.9%. Analysts predict the Nifty index may approach record highs, potentially surpassing the 25500 mark, which could act as a support level.

business.title: Oil Markets Are Betting on a Surplus That Hasn't Arrived Yet
business.summary: Oil prices are stable around $93 per barrel as predictions of a global supply surplus face challenges from ongoing Middle East tensions and shipping disruptions. Recent agency reports have heightened expectations for oversupply, yet the market remains cautious due to persistent attacks and stalled diplomatic efforts in the region, leading to uncertainty in future oil supply dynamics.

business.title: US futures bounce as AI rout rattles Asian stocks
business.summary: US stock futures increased on Monday as Asian markets faced declines, following a significant drop in technology and chip stocks linked to the AI sector. Authorities in Asia are working to stabilize the markets amid investor concerns. The recent volatility has raised questions about the sustainability of the AI boom and its impact on stock performance.

technology.title: Save up to $150 on two Apple Watch Ultra models ahead of Black Friday
technology.summary: Ahead of Black Friday, significant discounts on two Apple Watch Ultra models are available, allowing shoppers to save up to $150. Best Buy and Amazon are offering these deals, providing an opportunity for early holiday shopping. As Black Friday approaches, more deals are emerging, making it a good time to explore savings on popular electronics.

technology.title: 'Grand theft without auto': Shashi Tharoor's dig at Modi government's 2016 demonetisation over GTA 6. Watch video
technology.summary: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor criticized the Modi government's 2016 demonetisation by likening it to "grand theft without auto" in response to the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. His comment coincided with Rockstar Games announcing record pre-orders and first-day sales of USD 3.79 billion for the new game, highlighting the stark contrast between the two events.

sports.title: IND vs NZ first Test Day 5: New Zealand batters blunt Indian attack
sports.summary: New Zealand's batters effectively defended against India's bowling on Day 5 of the first Test at Basin Reserve. With partnerships from Conway, Ravindra, and Blundell, New Zealand reached 206 for five at tea, needing to hold out for a draw. India sought five wickets to secure a rare Test win in New Zealand, with 39 overs remaining.

sports.title: MCC says India-Pakistan handshake issue is beyond its control
sports.summary: MCC Laws Manager Fraser Stewart stated that the issue of players shaking hands between India and Pakistan is beyond the control of cricket's law custodians. Despite a desire for camaraderie, geopolitical tensions and higher directives prevent such gestures. During a recent match, players maintained stoic body language, reflecting the ongoing cold relations between the two teams.

sports.title: Carlos Alcaraz scripts history, becomes just fourth Tennis player ever to achieve rare feat with ATP Finals win over Zverev
sports.summary: Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals by defeating Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6 (7) on November 22, 2026, in Turin. This victory marks Alcaraz as the fourth player in tennis history to achieve this feat. The match showcased Alcaraz's skill as he continued his impressive performance throughout the tournament, further solidifying his status in the sport.

health.title: Could the time you eat affect the decisions you make?
health.summary: A study involving 28 women with overweight or obesity found that early time-restricted eating led to more impulsive monetary decisions compared to late eating. This behavior was linked to higher plasma tyrosine ratios, especially in women with impaired glucose metabolism. However, the small sample size limited the ability to determine underlying mechanisms or effects on daily behavior.

health.title: Julie Fleshman Calls for Greater Pancreatic Cancer Research Investment on World Pancreatic Cancer Day
health.summary: Julie Fleshman, President and CEO of the Pancreatic Cancer Action Network, emphasized the need for increased investment in pancreatic cancer research during World Pancreatic Cancer Day. She highlighted global awareness efforts and called for action to improve outcomes for patients. Fleshman’s remarks were shared on LinkedIn, reflecting a collective commitment to addressing the challenges posed by pancreatic cancer.

health.title: Glucose Data: How Pharmacists Turn Readings Into Next Steps
health.summary: Pharmacists play a crucial role in diabetes care by analyzing glucose data to identify patterns and resolve testing issues. They summarize findings and communicate them to the care team, ensuring timely interventions. This proactive approach enhances patient management by addressing potential problems before the next appointment, ultimately improving outcomes for individuals with diabetes through effective collaboration and communication.

science.title: Spacecraft Reaches Asteroid NASA Hit Hard in 2022 for the First-Ever Space Crash Site Investigation
science.summary: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has arrived at the 65803 Didymos asteroid system to investigate the impact site of NASA's DART mission, which successfully collided with the asteroid in September 2022. This marks the first-ever examination of a space crash site, aimed at understanding how to potentially alter the trajectory of asteroids in the future.

science.title: Drone operator in California warns fisherman of great white near swimmer
science.summary: A California fisherman swimming near his boat was approached by a juvenile great white shark, drawn by live fish. The situation was averted when a drone operator spotted the shark and alerted the fisherman. This incident highlights the effectiveness of drone technology in enhancing safety for individuals in marine environments, potentially preventing dangerous encounters with wildlife.

science.title: A California drone operator filming sharks from nearly two miles away spotted a large great white approaching a fisherman who had jumped into the water; he used the drone to warn the man, who climbed
science.summary: A California drone operator spotted a great white shark approaching a fisherman swimming near his boat. The operator, filming from nearly two miles away, used the drone to alert the man, who then climbed back onto the boat. The incident underscores the risks of ocean safety, as live fish hanging beside the boat may have attracted the shark.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 23, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 23, 2026, horoscopes emphasize the importance of clear intentions for the week. For Leos, relationships, particularly intimate ones, are highlighted. Singles are encouraged to reflect on their relationship history and the dynamics with past partners. The guidance suggests that understanding these aspects can lead to better connections and insights moving forward in personal relationships.

entertainment.title: A Tamil Nadu man packed grocery orders in freezing rooms and cycled up to 100 km delivering food while studying for CA exams; six months later, he joined the Bengaluru office he once looked at across
entertainment.summary: Parthiban Krishnamoorthi from Tamil Nadu faced challenges while preparing for his CA exams, including two failed attempts, night shifts, and delivering groceries by bicycle over 100 km. He worked in freezing rooms and often gazed at the BDO office in Bengaluru's Koramangala during breaks, dreaming of employment there. Six months later, he successfully joined the office he admired.

entertainment.title: Pisces Horoscope Today: November 23, 2026
entertainment.summary: This week, Pisces individuals are encouraged to observe their surroundings and embrace a sense of peace. They may find contentment with their current life circumstances and personal growth. This period allows for reflection and acceptance, leading to a harmonious state of mind. Overall, it is a time for Pisces to appreciate their journey and the present moment.
